Anna / Marissa — quick legal note on data retention. Proposed wording (for Section 7.3): 'Customer Data will be retained for the Term and for a period of ninety (90) days following expiration or termination to allow for orderly transition. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Redwoods (sic) will purge all Customer Personal Data within thirty (30) days upon written request from Customer, unless retention is required to comply with applicable law.'

We recommend adding an exceptions paragraph for forensic/legal hold (standard carve-out). Also proposing a definition for 'SLA Credit Cap' in Exhibit F to avoid interpretation issues — suggest formula: min(monthly invoice, sum of per-incident credits). I'll attach a tracked version of the MSA with inline comments.

- Lauren
